reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program

    Encodes:
      (1) The provided statute: CA St & Hwy Code  392 (as amended; used here for focus_year 2021)
      (2) The question scenario facts
      (3) A deterministic yes/no answer derived from the encoded statute logic (no hardcoded final answer)
*/

% --------------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% --------------------------

scenario_state(california).
focus_year(2021).

% The question being asked (modeled as a query target, not assumed true)
question_target(eviction_cases_first_heard_in(circuit_court)).

% Representative "eviction case" type for the scenario (generic, not a specific litigant)
scenario_eviction_case(case1).
case_kind(case1, eviction).
case_state(case1, california).
case_year(case1, 2021).

/* Helper predicate required by the prompt:
   Succeeds when the factual statement(s) of the scenario are satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(california),
    focus_year(2021),
    question_target(eviction_cases_first_heard_in(circuit_court)),
    scenario_eviction_case(Case),
    case_kind(Case, eviction),
    case_state(Case, california),
    case_year(Case, 2021).

% -----------------------------------------------
% Statute translation: CA St & Hwy Code  392
% (Note: statute content is about Route 92, not eviction courts.)
% -----------------------------------------------

/* Topic metadata to support reasoning about whether the provided statute is relevant
   to eviction-court jurisdiction questions. */
statute_id(ca_st_hwy_code_392, california, 2021).

statute_topic(ca_st_hwy_code_392, highways).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(a) (route description) */
statute_392_route92_segment(1, route_1_near_half_moon_bay, route_280).
statute_392_route92_segment(2, route_280, route_238_in_hayward).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(b) (relinquished former portion in City of Hayward) */
statute_392_relinquished_former_portion_not_state_highway(city_of_hayward).
statute_392_relinquished_former_portion_ineligible_for_adoption_under_section_81(city_of_hayward).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(b) and (c)(4) (duty to maintain signs) */
statute_392_city_must_maintain_signs_for_relinquished_portion(city_of_hayward).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(1) (commission may relinquish upon agreement) */
statute_392_commission_may_relinquish_to_city_if_agreement_exists(commission, city_of_hayward).

/* CA St & Hwy Code  392(c)(2) (effective immediately after recordation) */
statute_392_relinquishment_effective_upon_recordation.

% -----------------------------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% -----------------------------------------------

/* A statute addresses eviction jurisdiction only if its topic is eviction_jurisdiction.
   (No such statute is provided in this problem.) */
statute_addresses_eviction_jurisdiction(StatuteId) :-
    statute_topic(StatuteId, eviction_jurisdiction).

/* Derive a legal rule for "eviction cases are first heard in Court" only if there exists
   a statute addressing eviction jurisdiction that establishes that forum.
   Since the only provided statute is about highways, this will not derive any forum. */
legal_eviction_first_heard_in_court(State, Court, Year) :-
    statute_id(StatuteId, State, Year),
    statute_addresses_eviction_jurisdiction(StatuteId),
    statute_establishes_first_forum_for_eviction(StatuteId, Court).

/* No provided statute establishes a first forum for eviction; keep predicate defined
   (but with no facts) to avoid undefined predicate errors. */
statute_establishes_first_forum_for_eviction(_StatuteId, _Court) :-
    fail.

% -----------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate (must be deterministic yes/no)
% -----------------------------------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    (   legal_eviction_first_heard_in_court(State, circuit_court, Year)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

% -----------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in circuit court?
